items.title: Horace "One Leg Horse" White Interview, 1961-03-03
items.q: Yeah, I know Rabbit. ... Sometime I used to catch Rabbit. Say Rabbit, he say what? Say, you all playing tonight? ... I used to be on with all of them.

ctx.x: How long has he been gone? Oh, Buddy Bolin been gone a long time. Buddy Bolin been dead a long time. You remember when he, you remember, Buddy Bolin was, Buddy Bolin died when, you remember when they killed Keith Anderson? Yeah, I've heard about that. Well, all right. He died right after he killed Keith Anderson. You remember when Chief Anderson got killed? Yeah, I remember when Chief Anderson got killed. Oh, man. You see Orlean Street? Mm-hmm. Orlean Street, that used to be, that used to be a parish. On Orlean…

Do you remember that song they used to have about the downfall of the line, they called it? Yeah. Well... I think Rabbit used to sing it, the guy who played guitar? Yeah. Rabbit singing? Yeah, I know Rabbit.

Used to hang around James Alley? Yeah, I know. I used to bum in James Alley. Oh, you? I used to bum around James Alley. Eclip Alley. Mm-hmm. All around. All around up and down. Where's Eclip Alley? Right on Franklin and Gravy.
